verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a Cloud Backup feature explicitly designed to restore accounts on a new device after phone loss (docs-9, docs-13), which matches the story's claim of a documented recovery path. However, a concrete hands-on community report describes the opposite outcome — an app update wiped all backed-up data and locked the user out of every account, with the poster citing it as a known reliability issue (comm-1, comm-3) — directly contradicting the documented recovery guarantee. missing for 10: independent verification that Cloud Backup restore reliably works, resolution of the reported wipe/lockout bug, and clarity on how backup interacts with app updates.
